data.title: 拉毗 · 仓库门口的两列清单
data.description: 前哨仓库刚开门，拉毗把收货夹板搁到最上层木箱，用戴半指手套的手把受潮的一页压平。她抬头确认箱身上的刻号，耳麦的指示灯还亮着，晨光从半开的门外照到靴面。
data.location: 前哨物资仓库卸货门口
data.action: 一手压平夹板清单，抬头比对叠箱刻号
data.lighting: 仓门切入一道浅白晨光，照亮靴面和木箱棱角
data.promptProse: Rapi checks a stack of supply crates at the open depot door. One fingerless glove flattens a damp sheet against her clipboard while she looks up at the numbers on the wooden boxes. Red piping follows the edge of her black crop top under the tactical harness, and the first daylight lands across her scuffed boots.
data.animaCaption: Her headset is still on while she compares the sheet against the crate directly above it.
